I'll search hotels in Lisbon for those dates and load the relevant city skills.# Lisbon Long Weekend — Draft Itinerary (13–16 Nov 2026)

**Overview**: Lisbon 3 nights, one base, no hotel changes | light · standard · standard · light
(Note: this is a Lisbon trip, so the Japan-specific city skills don't apply; the plan below follows general city-break pacing.)

**Before you go**
- Mid-November is cool and can be showery — pack a light rain layer and comfortable walking shoes for the hills and cobbles.
- Book any timed-entry or popular dinner spots a few weeks ahead (please check current availability).
- Get a Viva Viagem / contactless transit card at the airport or a metro station for trams, metro and buses.
- Ask the hotel about airport transfer or taxi options if you land late.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Baixa / Chiado (light)**
- Afternoon: Lisbon Airport → city centre by metro (red line toward Saldanha/São Sebastião, approx. 20–25 min, 1 transfer to Baixa-Chiado) or taxi, approx. 20 min
- Check in and rest
- 17:30 Short walk in Baixa and Praça do Comércio — riverside square is calmest in the evening light
- 19:30 Dinner near Chiado, early night
- Tonight: My Story Hotel Tejo (太加斯我的故事酒店)

**Day 2 | Alfama · Castelo · Mouraria (standard)**
- 09:00 Tram 28 or walk up to Castelo de São Jorge area — go early, queues build later (approx. 15 min by tram)
- 11:00 Wander Alfama lanes and viewpoints (Miradouro de Santa Luzia), approx. 10 min walk between stops
- 13:00 Lunch in Alfama
- 15:00 Rest at the hotel, approx. 15 min walk back
- 17:00 Mouraria and Martim Moniz for an evening stroll; dinner nearby
- Alternatives: if rain, swap the castle walk for the Tile Museum (Museu Nacional do Azulejo) indoors; if tired, drop the Mouraria loop
- Tonight: My Story Hotel Tejo (太加斯我的故事酒店)

**Day 3 | Belém (standard)**
- 09:00 Baixa → Belém by tram 15E, approx. 25 min, no transfer
- 09:45 Jerónimos Monastery and Belém Tower exteriors — arrive early, both get crowded (approx. 10 min walk apart)
- 12:30 Lunch and pastéis de Belém
- 14:30 Riverside walk or MAAT museum
- 17:00 Return by tram, approx. 25 min
- Alternatives: if rain, spend the afternoon inside the Maritime Museum or MAAT; if tired, drop the riverside walk
- Tonight: My Story Hotel Tejo (太加斯我的故事酒店)

**Day 4 | Departure (light)**
- Morning: breakfast and a last stroll near the hotel only
- Check-out and head to Lisbon Airport by metro or taxi, approx. 20–25 min; leave plenty of time for check-in

Hotel options I recommend are shown in the cards above — My Story Hotel Tejo is the closest to the historic centre and best value, Hotel Mundial is a comfortable 4-star alternative, and Corpo Santo is the splurge. Prices and availability should be re-checked before booking.

items.summary: Central 4-star by Martim Moniz square, walkable to Alfama and Baixa; lowest price of the central options.
Closest to the historic centre (approx. 205 m), good value for a couple's long weekend.
